findings.label: Silent no-partner fallback
findings.description: When lat/lng are blank, tryAssignPartner returns null silently. The booking is created with status 'pending' and no partner but the customer success screen gives no indication. Either surface a message or make lat/lng required.

findings.label: Confirm button not disabled on missing address
findings.description: handleConfirm guards with an early return and shows addressError, but the button disabled condition only checks !paymentMethod || submitting. Add !serviceAddress.trim() to the disabled prop.

findings.label: Late-timestamp slot injection — startAt not snapped
findings.description: The 60-second tolerance accepts a client startAt up to 59s past a slot boundary, but the unsnapped client value is stored in MongoDB. Downstream conflict checks that assume startAt is on a canonical boundary will drift. Snap startAt to slotMatch.startAt after the match.

findings.label: TOCTOU window in per-partner conflict check
findings.description: Two concurrent assignment calls for different bookings at the same slot both read conflict=0 before either commits, allowing the same partner to be double-booked. The findOneAndUpdate atomic guard only prevents the same booking being assigned twice, not the same partner receiving two overlapping bookings.
